title: Rig driver cab using Viktor crew reference (approved v3)
why: Replace the floating generic bust with a seated existing crew member and readable driving controls.
author: Codex art analyst
acceptance: Parames approved preview version 3 on 2026-10-26 ('the last one (3) is ok') and requested this ticket. Match rig-driver-viktor-study.png under tools/art/micro/previews/driver-detail-v1. The generated 1254x1254 study is a visual target, not a production texture: redraw at native size.
Emit one new fully opaque 17x17 atlas sprite decal_rig_driver_cockpit using only the listed 12 master-palette colors. Keep veh_rig and ext_rig at 280x300.

Replace only side-window interior x=17..33, y=193..209, inclusive. Anchor (17,193), top-left, in veh_rig pixels. Preserve the existing black frame at x=16/34 and y=192/210; do not enlarge the opening or vehicle.

Use actual dw_crew_viktor 14x20 sit cell 6 as reference, mirrored to face left. Keep the crew-sized approximately 8x8 head, tiny dark vertical eye, stepped left-projecting nose, gray fur cap, pale skin, gray beard/bone collar, snow-blue coat and narrow torso. Adapt only the arm/upper-body pose needed to drive. Hide the lower body behind the sill instead of shrinking the head.

Viktor looks left toward the windshield, with one nose projecting left and the cap/head back on the right. His short left-reaching arm and hand meet a small steering wheel. Keep cap, face and hand readable at 1x.

Completely cover the original bright yellow fill and generic olive bust. Compose dark gray1 interior, compact gray3/gray5 dash and wheel on the left, narrow worn wood1/gray3 seat back on the right, and a tiny lamp1 overhead practical lamp. Add one gray5 or cream2 dial and one lamp1 powered indicator. Saturation belongs only to physical lights; no broad yellow fill or glow.

Bake the decal at (17,193) into both veh_rig and ext_rig after weathering and before final atlas quantization, and emit the standalone decal. Static art-only change: feature=null, no new driver mechanic, runtime overlay or animation. Do not change the shared driver() helper for other tiers.

After regeneration, decoded veh_rig/ext_rig pixels outside [17,193,17,17] must match pre-change sprites exactly. Other vehicles, crew strips, all cab_rig state sprites, room holes, engine trim, windshield, exhaust, markers, shell geometry and hit regions retain their artwork and behavior. Compare cropped sprite contents because atlas coordinates can repack.

Use one-native-pixel soot outlines, flat clusters, binary alpha, nearest filtering and integer placement. No antialiasing, gradients, fine scratches, rotation, fractional scaling or thick framing. Inspect before/after at 1x and nearest 4x/8x.

Preserve approved target, actual crew/cab crops, prompts, approval manifest and native production source in a tracked reference/source folder with .gdignore when appropriate; tools/art/micro is git-ignored. Record hashes/provenance, and ensure the generator reproduces the accepted result on full regeneration.

Run micro_asset.py verify for this ticket after generation and verify exact size, palette, opacity and outside-window pixel stability. Show close-ups and in-game rig in cut-away/exterior and day/night. Follow CLAUDE.md required autotest, web export, README/changelog and staging PR workflow; no feature-PR version bump.
notes: Rig v3 approved by Parames on 2026-10-26. User additionally requested crew-based drivers for ALL vehicles. This is the rig child of the four-vehicle art epic. Geometry: top=188; inner window (17,193),17x17. Separate engine room (2,222),33x41. Static art-only change, no driver-assignment mechanic or paid generation. Claude builds; if readability cannot fit, comment and request a decision rather than silently changing geometry.
